note: The fixed-price CSR projects on csr.html and their one-page PDFs (media/csr). Built by scripts/build-csr-projects.js. Costs researched 3 Nov 2026; construction, equipment and fit-out lines are estimates to confirm with local quotes.

projects.name: Animal ambulance, one year on the road
projects.pitch: One fully fitted animal ambulance for a PFA unit, with its crew, fuel and medicines paid for the first full year.
projects.what: 1 new ambulance van (Tata Winger or Force Traveller class, high roof) fitted for animals, plus 12 months of operation
projects.scale: 1 vehicle, 1 driver, 1 para-vet rescuer, about 80 km a day, helpline number
projects.time: 12 months of operation after delivery (vehicle remains with the PFA unit)
projects.where: One PFA unit's city or district

lines.item: Ambulance van, ex-showroom (high roof, non-AC)
Animal fit-out: stretcher, 2 cages, loading ramp, restraint kit, oxygen, first-aid cabinet, light bar and siren, GPS, branding
Registration, road tax and first-year insurance
Driver, 12 months at Rs 22,500
Para-vet rescuer, 12 months at Rs 25,000
Diesel, 80 km a day, 365 days, 10 km per litre, Rs 90 per litre
Servicing, tyres and PUC
Medicines, dressings and rescue consumables, Rs 10,000 a month
Helpline phone and GPS data
Admin, monitoring and funder reporting

outcomes: Animals rescued and transported (target 1,500 in the year, about 4 to 5 calls a day)
Average response time from call to pickup
Animals treated on site
Km driven and GPS trip log
Monthly photo report and year-end report with case stories
suits: Mid-size companies wanting a visible, branded asset
projects.smaller: Year 2 running cost only: about Rs 11.5 lakh (crew, fuel, medicines, insurance, servicing, admin)

projects.name: Sterilise a town: 1,000 dogs
projects.pitch: Humanely sterilise and vaccinate 1,000 street dogs in one town under the Animal Birth Control Rules 2023, to bring down litters, bites and rabies.
projects.what: Catch, sterilise, vaccinate against rabies, care for and return 1,000 street dogs to the same street
projects.scale: 1,000 dogs, ear-notched, with before and after headcount surveys
projects.where: One town or a set of municipal wards, with the local body's consent

lines.item: Humane capture, transport and return to the same spot, 1,000 dogs at Rs 200
Pre-op check, surgery, anaesthesia, anti-rabies vaccine, post-op care and food, 1,000 dogs at Rs 1,450
Baseline and end-line dog headcount, ear-notch checks
Resident and feeder awareness (notices, ward meetings)
Admin, monitoring and funder reporting

outcomes: Dogs sterilised (1,000), split male and female
Dogs vaccinated against rabies (1,000)
Share of the town's dogs sterilised, from before and after headcounts (aim 70%, the national target)
Surgical complication and mortality rate
Dog-bite cases reported at the local hospital, before and after (where data is shared)
suits: Mid-size companies near the town (plants, offices)
projects.schedule: Item (iv) animal welfare (with item (i) preventive health care for the rabies element)
projects.smaller: Rs 1,800 per dog all-in; sold in blocks of 500 dogs (Rs 9 lakh)
projects.note: Run by a PFA unit recognised by the Animal Welfare Board of India for this work, with the local body's agreement, under the Animal Birth Control Rules, 2023.

projects.name: Rabies-free district: 10,000 dogs
projects.pitch: Vaccinate 10,000 street and community dogs against rabies in one district in about 3 months, with a coverage survey to prove it.
projects.what: Mass anti-rabies vaccination of free-roaming and community dogs, each marked and logged
projects.scale: 10,000 dogs vaccinated, 4 field teams, 1 supervising vet, coverage survey
projects.where: One district or a large city zone

lines.item: Veterinary anti-rabies vaccine, 10,500 doses (5% wastage) at Rs 50
Cold chain: vaccine cool boxes, ice packs, fridge hire
Field teams: 4 teams x 3 people x 60 days at Rs 800 a day
Supervising vet, 3 months at Rs 60,000
Vehicle hire: 4 vehicles x 60 days at Rs 2,500
Marking paint or collars, mobile data app, ID tags
Awareness and dog-bite first-aid talks in schools and wards
Post-drive coverage survey
Admin, monitoring and funder reporting

outcomes: Dogs vaccinated (10,000), mapped by ward
Vaccination coverage from the post-drive survey (aim 70% or more)
People reached with dog-bite first-aid messages
Human dog-bite and rabies cases at district hospitals, before and after (where shared)
suits: Pharma, especially vaccine and animal health makers (vaccine can be given in kind)
projects.schedule: Item (iv) animal welfare and item (i) preventive health care (rabies is a human health risk)
projects.smaller: About Rs 2.3 lakh per 1,000 dogs; if the vaccine is donated in kind, the cash price is about Rs 17.9 lakh for 10,000 dogs
projects.note: Vaccine can also be given in kind by a vaccine maker, lowering the price.

projects.name: Village vet assistants: 25 trained
projects.pitch: Train 25 young people from villages with no vet nearby to give first aid, deworm, vaccinate and call for help, then equip and mentor them for six months.
projects.what: A 3-month course (1 month residential at a PFA hospital, 2 months supervised field work), a first-aid kit each, certification and 6 months of mentoring
projects.where: One block or district cluster of villages around a PFA hospital

lines.item: Training: trainers, practicals at the PFA hospital, course material, 25 x Rs 30,000
Board and lodging for the 30-day residential month, 25 x 30 days x Rs 500
Field placement stipend, 25 x 2 months x Rs 5,000
First-aid and vaccination kit per graduate, 25 x Rs 15,000
Third-party assessment and certification, 25 x Rs 1,000
Six months of mentoring, refresher day, phone support from PFA vets
Trainee travel
Admin, monitoring and funder reporting

outcomes: People trained and certified (25)
Graduates still active after 6 months (aim 20 or more)
Animals given first aid, dewormed or vaccinated by graduates, logged monthly
Villages covered
Share of women trainees
projects.schedule: Item (iv) animal welfare and item (ii) employment-enhancing vocational skills
projects.smaller: Rs 84,000 per trainee; minimum batch about 13 (A-HELP needs at least half a batch of 25)
projects.note: Graduates give first aid and support under a veterinarian's supervision, as the Indian Veterinary Council Act, 1984 allows.

projects.name: Mobile vet clinic for villages, one year
projects.pitch: A clinic on wheels with a vet and para-vet that visits the same villages every week, treating cows, buffaloes, goats, bullocks, donkeys and horses where there is no vet.
projects.what: 1 van with a treatment cabin and equipment, plus a vet, para-vet, driver, fuel and medicines for 12 months
projects.scale: 1 vehicle, fixed weekly route of about 25 villages, about 280 clinic days
projects.time: 12 months of operation (van remains with the PFA unit)

lines.item: Van with clinical cabin, treatment table, storage, fridge and equipment
Veterinarian, 12 months at Rs 60,000
Para-vet, 12 months at Rs 25,000
Driver-cum-attendant, 12 months at Rs 22,500
Diesel
Medicines, dewormers, mineral mixture, dressings
Servicing and insurance
Admin, monitoring and funder reporting

outcomes: Animal treatments given (target 8,000 in the year)
Villages and farming households served
Animals dewormed and vaccinated
Working animals treated for harness and neck wounds
Clinic days run against plan
projects.schedule: Item (iv) animal welfare (also item (x) rural development projects)
projects.smaller: Year 2 running cost only: about Rs 19.7 lakh (DAHD recurring norm + admin)

projects.name: Recovery ward: 20 kennels and a year of care
projects.pitch: Build a clean, covered recovery ward of 20 steel kennels at a PFA shelter, and pay for a full year of care for the animals in it.
projects.what: A roofed ward of about 1,000 sq ft with washable sloped floors and drains, 20 stainless steel kennels, water and power, plus 12 months of care
projects.scale: 20 kennels, about 700 recoveries a year at a 10-day average stay
projects.time: About 4 months to build, then 12 months of care

lines.item: Ward shell: steel frame, insulated roof, sloped washable floor, drains, about 1,000 sq ft at Rs 1,500
20 stainless steel kennels at Rs 55,000
Water lines, drainage and washing point
Fans, lights and wiring
One year of care for 20 animals at Rs 3,035 a month
Admin, monitoring and funder reporting

outcomes: Kennels built (20) and handed over with photos
Animals recovered and released or adopted (target about 700 a year)
Recovery and survival rate
Adoptions
suits: Real estate and construction (in-kind build possible)
Mid-size companies wanting a named, permanent asset
projects.smaller: Build only (no care year): about Rs 30 lakh; half ward of 10 kennels with a year of care about Rs 20 lakh

projects.name: Hospital diagnostics: X-ray, ultrasound, lab
projects.pitch: Give a PFA hospital the X-ray, ultrasound and blood-test machines it needs to find out quickly what is wrong with an injured or sick animal.
projects.what: Digital X-ray with table, room shielding, a veterinary ultrasound, a haematology analyser and a biochemistry analyser, installed with staff training
projects.time: About 3 months to install and license, then a year of service cover

lines.item: Digital X-ray system with table
Room lead shielding and AERB registration
Portable veterinary ultrasound with 2 probes
Veterinary haematology analyser
Semi-automatic biochemistry analyser with starter reagents
Staff training and first-year service cover
Admin, monitoring and funder reporting

outcomes: X-rays taken (target 2,000 a year)
Ultrasound scans (target 1,000 a year)
Blood tests run (target 3,000 a year)
Animals referred out for imaging, before and after (should fall)
projects.smaller: X-ray only (with shielding and admin): about Rs 15.2 lakh; ultrasound and lab only: about Rs 9.5 lakh
projects.note: Includes the X-ray room's registration with the Atomic Energy Regulatory Board.

projects.name: Cattle shelter: shade, water and care
projects.pitch: Give about 150 rescued and abandoned cattle shade from the sun, clean drinking water, a dry fodder store and a year of vet visits.
projects.what: An open-sided shade shed of about 4,000 sq ft, a water point with pump, tank and 6 troughs, a fodder store, fans and foggers, and 12 months of vet visits and medicines
projects.time: About 4 months to build, then 12 months of vet care

lines.item: Open-sided shade shed, about 4,000 sq ft, steel frame and insulated roof, at Rs 350
Drinking water: borewell or solar pump, 10,000 litre tank, 6 troughs
Dry fodder store, about 600 sq ft
Fans and foggers for summer heat
Vet visits and medicines for 12 months
Admin, monitoring and funder reporting

outcomes: Cattle with shade and clean water (about 150)
Sq ft of shade built
Deaths in summer months, before and after
Cattle treated by the visiting vet
suits: Mid-size companies (cattle shelters are the most common animal cause in company CSR filings)
projects.smaller: Shade and water only: about Rs 19 lakh
